project.name: Snowboard Prep PWA - Bug Fixes
project.description: QA-identified bug fixes for iOS sound, multi-sided timers, voice counting, and UX improvements

tasks.title: Fix iOS sound effects and silent mode bypass
tasks.description: Replace Web Audio API with HTML5 audio elements to fix iOS PWA sound issues and bypass silent mode. Sounds should always play when app is open, regardless of device silent switch.
criteria: Generate MP3 audio files for all sounds (timer-complete, side-transition, set-complete, click)
SoundContext.tsx updated to use HTML5 <audio> elements instead of Web Audio API oscillators
Preload audio files on context mount
Add playSideTransition() sound function for timer side transitions
Sounds play reliably on iOS 26 PWA with silent mode enabled
Sounds work on timer completion (not direct user interaction)
Fallback to Web Audio API if audio files fail to load

tasks.title: Add visual auto-advance countdown indicator
tasks.description: Add circular progress countdown overlay showing when app will auto-advance to next activity, eliminating confusion about manual vs automatic advancement
criteria: Auto-advance overlay appears after activity completion (when not last activity)
Large countdown number displayed in center
GO NOW button allows immediate advancement
Overlay doesn't appear on last activity (requires manual FINISH)
Rest period screen (if configured) takes precedence over auto-advance countdown
Navigation button labels updated for clarity (SKIP ACTIVITY, FINISH WORKOUT)

tasks.title: Implement auto-switching multi-sided timer
tasks.description: Enhance ActivityTimer to automatically switch between left/right sides for timed exercises, splitting duration evenly and providing clear visual/audio feedback during transitions
criteria: ActivityTimer accepts new props: side, sideLabels
Timer splits duration between sides (e.g., 60s = 30s left + 30s right)
Side indicator shows current side label and progress (Side 1 of 2)
Timer auto-transitions to next side when current side completes
Progress bar shows overall completion across all sides
Buffer time only applies before first side
ActivityScreen passes side props to ActivityTimer

tasks.title: Create VoiceContext for Web Speech API
tasks.description: Create a new context to manage Web Speech API for voice synthesis (counting out loud) and voice recognition (commands). Handle browser compatibility and graceful degradation.
criteria: VoiceContext.tsx created with provider and hook
Detect SpeechSynthesis availability (works on all browsers)
Detect SpeechRecognition availability (Chrome/Edge only, not iOS Safari)
speak() function for voice output with configurable rate, pitch, volume
startListening() for voice recognition with command callback
Handle webkit prefixes for Safari compatibility
iOS limitation documented (voice counting works, commands don't)
Error handling for permission denied, not supported, recognition failures

tasks.title: Add voice settings to SettingsContext
tasks.description: Extend Settings interface with voice-related configuration options and ensure they persist to localStorage

tasks.title: Implement voice counting in RepCounter
tasks.description: Add automatic voice counting to RepCounter that counts reps out loud at configurable pace, replacing the need for manual tapping during exercises
criteria: Import and use VoiceContext in RepCounter
voiceCountingActive state tracks if voice counting is running
Voice counting interval advances reps automatically at configured pace
Speaks rep number on each count ('1', '2', '3', etc.)
Voice counting stops when activity completes
Voice counting interval cleanup on unmount
Start/Stop Voice Counting button added to UI
Visual indicator shows when voice counting is active
Manual NEXT REP button remains as fallback
Only works when voiceCountingEnabled and synthesisAvailable
Graceful degradation if voice not supported

tasks.title: Implement voice commands in RepCounter
tasks.description: Add voice command recognition to RepCounter allowing hands-free rep advancement via spoken commands like 'next', 'count', 'pause', 'resume'
criteria: Voice recognition starts when voiceCommandsEnabled and recognitionAvailable
Only available on Chrome/Edge (graceful degradation on iOS/Safari/Firefox)
Permission handling with user-friendly error messages

tasks.title: Add Voice Assistance section to Settings UI
tasks.description: Create settings UI for voice features with toggles, sliders, browser compatibility indicators, and test buttons
criteria: Voice Assistance section added to Settings page
Browser compatibility warning shown if voice not supported
Voice Counting toggle with availability indicator
Voice Commands toggle with iOS unavailability note
Test Voice button with immediate feedback
Settings UI shows/hides based on voice availability

tasks.title: Add VoiceProvider to App component hierarchy
tasks.description: Integrate VoiceProvider into the App.tsx provider hierarchy and add CSS styling for voice UI elements
criteria: VoiceProvider added to App.tsx after SoundProvider
CSS added for .voice-listening-indicator with pulse animation
